name: Khorne Berzerker

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: The GM gains 1 point of Ruin at the start of this Threat's Turns.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 1 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Mark of Chaos
bonuses.text: This Threat has a Mark of Chaos KHORNE (Wrath & Glory, p.136)

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Gain bonus dice and options for actions from Space Marine Implants (Wrath & Glory, p. 75)

bonuses.name: Eternal Bloodlust
bonuses.text: This Threat's maximum Shock is doubled (included in profile).

abilities.name: Kill! Maim! Burn!
abilities.text: This Threat may make 2 attacks each Turn without penalty. If dual wielding, it makes 1 attack with each weapon.

abilities.name: Veteran of the Long War
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to add the game's Tier in ED to all attacks this Threat makes this Round.

options.name: Mob Actions
options.text: For every 8 Berzerkers in a Mob, one member may replace their weapons with the following options. Two-handed weapons replace both pistol and chainaxe.

note: Resilience printed 13(5AR). Bolt Pistol and Chainaxe print no AP.
